title: Parent Signature Link
scenario: A message says your parent must sign a field-trip form through a strange short link.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Parent Signature Link: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Parents should use official school communication routes.
